Black cats were good luck first.

British sailors kept a black ship's cat for safe passage and their wives kept one at home for the same reason. In Edo period Japan a black cat warded off evil and drew good fortune.

The bad luck version is the newer, narrower story.

She's not a cat. But the black girls have always been the good luck around here.
